verdict.rationale: Pipecat is an agent-building framework, so grounding agents on user documents is an applicable axis, but the evidence shows no built-in knowledge base or RAG feature. The context-hub indexes Pipecat's own docs for coding agents, not the developer's content for the bot. Flows functions that call external systems are only developer building blocks for constructing retrieval.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ground the agent on my documents with a built-in knowledge base or RAG so it answers from my content
